Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To couple two units in normal conditions.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To couple two units in normal conditions.
initial_conditions: - V1 and V2 vehicles Switched ON.
- V1 and V2 enabled cabins rest in front of each other separated by a gap.
- Coupling Mode is Active (V1 and V2).
- Forward direction is selected in enabled cabin of V1 and V2

test_actions.text:
In active CABIN (V1):
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Coupling System Open"
Coupler Cover is opened and Coupler is extended in below sequence:
1. Coupler Cover opened. Check Inputs.
2. Coupler folding joints starts unlocking. Check Inputs
3. Coupler starts unfolding (extending). Check Inputs
4. Coupler folding joints starts locking. Check Inputs

In active CABIN (V2):
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Coupling System Open"
Coupler Cover is opened and Coupler is extended in below sequence:
1. Coupler Cover opened. Check Inputs.
2. Coupler folding joints starts unlocking. Check Inputs
3. Coupler starts unfolding (extending). Check Inputs
4. Coupler folding joints starts locking. Check Inputs

In Active CABIN (V2):
- PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
- Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
- Move back again the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area

- The Vehicle V2 moves towards the Vehicle V1
- Vehicles V1 and V2 couple
Wait for approx. 120 seconds
The new Vehicle configuration is shown in the HMI.
Check alarm

On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" 
symbol will illuminate.

On Loop Screen in HMI following information is showed
"Traction inhibited : Emergency Brake 1/2"
"Brake Loop: More than one cabin active"

In CABIN (V2):
- Move direction selector from V to 0 position
- Deactivate the cabin switching Cab Active Key from 1 to 0
Alarm Reset.

In Active CABIN (V1):
- PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
- Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
- Move the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area
Nothing happens.

In CABIN (V1):
- Move direction selector from V to 0 position
- Deactivate the cabin switching Cab Active Key from 1 to 0

In an EXTREME cabin:
- Active 10A01 switching Cab Active Key from 0 to 1
- Move direction selector from 0 to V position
The Vehicle configuration is shown in the HMI.

In the EXTREME cabin:
- PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
- Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
- Move the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area
The Vehicle moves forward.

In the EXTREME cabin:
- Move the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to the service Brake area.
Wait for the Vehicle to stop.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To uncouple two units in normal conditions.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To uncouple two units in normal conditions.

test_actions.text:
In an INTERMEDIATE cabin:
- Active 10A01 switching Cab Active Key from 0 to 1
- Press decoupling PB 62S01
The coupling disengages.

In CABIN:
- Move direction selector from 0 to R position
- PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
- Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
- Move the PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle to Propulsion area
Units become uncoupled.
The Vehicle configuration is shown in the HMI.

Test steps are independent of  cabine.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Vehicle Switch OFF forced  from HMI
Test procedure demonstrates the process to inmediate switch OFF the vehicle.
Test steps are independent of  cabine.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN
- Move direction selector from V to 0 position

Deactive the cabin, moving to 0 position.
At HMI, PB  to force the battery disconection is Active.
Press the pushbutton to disconnect the battery.

Ivanto Router(80A10) in C2 cars
Confort Network 2(88A02) in C2 cars
Radio Rack (80A01) in C2 cars
Automatic Person Counter system (97A05) in C2 cars

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Test procedure demonstrates the process to switch on the vehicle from cleaning mode when the vehicle is switched off.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Test procedure demonstrates the process to switch on the vehicle from cleaning mode when the vehicle is switched off.

test_actions.text: Enable the Cleaning mode by pressing cleaning PB 10S20
Cleaning pushbutton lamp is ON
Pantograph is up
Cabin lights ON
Passengers lights ON
HVAC is OFF
Right side doors are released, but stays closed.
Baby Carriage is Active
LEFT and RIGHT HMI will be OFF
Command to open single door via the exterior open pushnutton
Door opens and stay open
Command again pushbutton to close the door
Door closes
In the cabin, Move 10A01 direction switch to position 1
CLEANING mode is disabled and the mode "CAB CHANGE" is set up as there is not cab Active in the vehicle
The doors must be closed by retracting the child carriage function (acoustic and optical signalling, door locking) and vehicle switch off
Internal lights switch to EMERGENCY MODE
In this situation, press again cleaning PB 10S20
Nothing happens
Place 10A01 direction switch in position 0 and  press again cleaning PB 10S20
Cleaning mode will be ON and push button lamp will be ON
5 minutes after, press again cleaning PB 10S20 in any cabin of the composition.
Cleaning mode active time has been reactivated from the beginning
In the cabin, Move 10A01 direction switch to position 1
CLEANING mode is destroyed and the mode "CAB CHANGE" is set up as there is not cab Active in the vehicle
The doors must be closed by retracting the child carriage function (acoustic and optical signalling, door locking) and vehicle switch off
Internal lights switch to EMERGENCY MODE
Place 10A01 direction switch in position 0
Nothing happens
Press again cleaning PB 10S20
Cleaning mode will be ON and push button lamp will be ON
Let passing the time 30mins, and before the end of the cleaning mode (elapsed time)
The doors must be closed by retracting the child carriage function (acoustic and optical signalling, door locking)
When cleaning mode time finish
Vehicle switch off

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check EB1/2 application due to loss of vehicle integrity.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check EB1/2 application due to loss of vehicle integrity.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.
- Passenger Alarm is not activated in the vehicle.
- Tear Off Brake Bypass Switch 33S02 NOT operated in any Cab.
- Sufficient Track length available for vehicle movement.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at slow speed (approx. 3 Kmph)
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Operate Tear Off Brake Bypass Switch 33S02
Operation of Tear Off Brake Bypass Switch 33S02 is recorded in Event Recorder.

In C1 Car:
- Simulate loss of vehicle integrity by removing the cable 33210.02 from XT14.115 05a
- Disconnect cable 62111.03 from relay 62K03 (X1)
In C2 Car:
- Disconnect cable 62111.03 from relay 62K03 (X1)
Nothing happens. vehicle continue to move.

In Active CABIN:
- Reset Tear Off Brake Bypass Switch 33S02
Emergency Brakes are applied in both units.
Check Inputs

On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" 
symbol will illuminate.

On Loop Screen in HMI following information is showed
"Traction inhibited : Emergency Brake 1/2"
"Brake Loop: Loss of integrity between units"
Track Brakes are applied in the non-active units. Check Input

In Active CABIN:
- Wait for the vehicle to Stop.
- Slowly move the master controller forward (towards Traction region).
Nothing happens. Traction is inhibited & vehicle remains at Standstill.

In C1 Car:
- Re-connect back the cable 33210.02 from XT14.115 05a
XT14.115 05a
- Re-connect cable 62111.03 from relay 62K03 (X1)
In C2 Car:
- Re-connect cable 62111.03 from relay 62K03 (X1)
Check Inputs
Emergency Brakes are released in both units
On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" symbol will be OFF.

On Loop Screen in HMI messages dissapeared
"Traction inhibited : Emergency Brake 1/2"
"Brake Loop: Loss of integrity between units"
Track Brakes are released in all units. Check Input

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Propulsion Loop is reset

In Active CABIN:
- Slowly move the master controller forward (towards Traction region).
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller back to Coasting region and apply service brake.
vehicle Stops.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To perform Brake Loop Test
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To perform Brake Loop Test
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.
- Passenger Alarm is not activated in the vehicle.
- Move master controller to apply service brake.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual PB "EMERGENCY BRAKE TEST".
Emergency Brakes are applied in both the Cars during the test.
Check Alarm

On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" symbol 
will illuminate during the test.

In C2 Car:
- Additionally connect +24Vdc supply to TB XT51.101: 03a through external 1.5 sq.mm. cable.
Nothing happens.

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual PB "EMERGENCY BRAKE TEST" again.
Emergency Brakes are not applied
Check Alarm

In C2 Car:
- Remove the external +24Vdc supply cable from TB XT51.101: 03a
Nothing happens.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check EB3 application during vehicle movement.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check EB3 application during vehicle movement.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.
- Sufficient Track length available for vehicle movement.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at a speed of approx. 5 Km/h.
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller to Emergency position.
Emergency Brakes are applied in the vehicle.
Track Brakes are applied in the vehicle. Check Input

On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" symbol
 will illuminate.

On Loop Screen in HMI following message will appear:
"Traction inhibited: Emergency Brake 3"
EB3 application is recorded in Event recorder.

In Active CABIN:
- Wait for the vehicle to Stop.
- Move the master controller back to Coasting.
Emergency Brakes are released.
Track Brakes are released. Check Input
On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" symbol will stop illuminating.

On Loop Screen in HMI messages dissapeared
"Traction inhibited : Emergency brake 3"
Check alarm

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Propulsion Loop is reset
Alarm Reset.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check EB3 application during standstill condition.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check EB3 application during standstill condition.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller to Emergency position.
Emergency Brakes are applied in the vehicle.
Track Brakes are NOT applied in the vehicle. Check Input

On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" symbol 
will illuminate.

On Loop Screen in HMI following message will appear:
"Traction inhibited: Emergency Brake 3"
EB3 application is recorded in Event recorder.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller back to Coasting.
Emergency Brakes are released.
On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" symbol will stop illuminating.

On Loop Screen in HMI messages dissapeared
"Traction inhibited : Emergency brake 3"
Check Alarm

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
Propulsion Loop is reset
Alarm Reset.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Auxiliary Release of Parking Brakes
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Auxiliary Release of Parking Brakes
initial_conditions: - HV is connected to the vehicle
- Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- Press the Parking Brake pushbutton (32S02)
Safety Brakes are applied in the vehicle.
Brake application status is shown on HMI.

In Active CABIN:
- Operate Parking Brake Bypass Switch 32S06.
Check Variables
Check Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, isolate any bogie in the composition.
Check Variables
Wait for approx. 30 seconds
Bogie Safety Brake is hydraulically released.
Check Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, isolate a second bogie in the composition.
Check Variables
Wait for approx. 30 seconds
Bogie Safety Brake is hydraulically released.
Alarms Reset.
Check Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- Verify it is not possible to isolate more than 1/3 of the total number of bogies from the HMI.
Nothing happens.

In Active CABIN:
- Reset Parking Brake Bypass Switch 32S06.
Bogie Safety Brake is applied again in all bogies.
Check Variables
Alarms Reset.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify opening of a door will open the propulsion loop is open. Each door interruption in the All Doors closed Loop is already tested in other procedure, in this procedure only single door will be checked.
During these Test vehicle can be moved. Pay attention to avoid the presence of any person in the vehicle exterior.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
Verify opening of a door will open the propulsion loop is open. Each door interruption in the All Doors closed Loop is already tested in other procedure, in this procedure only single door will be checked.
During these Test vehicle can be moved. Pay attention to avoid the presence of any person in the vehicle exterior.
initial_conditions: -HV is connected to the vehicle and pantographs is up.
- Doors are closed and not released

test_actions.text:

Test_Cases.name:

To check the Compressor operation in Normal mode.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Compressor operation in Normal mode.
initial_conditions: - Compressor Circuit Breaker is not tripped (IO2_C1_IS_COMP_CB = 0)
- Compressor cotactor is not manually switched off
- Compressor Isolation Valve is Open (IO1_C1_IS_COMP_OFF = 0 and IO2_C1_IS_COMP_NO_OFF = 1)

test_actions.text:
In Car-C1 (in a unit with no active cabin):
- Manually reduce the air pressure below PM_MIN_PRESSURE

Read Pressure value and pressure switch signal, 
When decreases under 8.3 bars, pressure switch signal changes
Compressors Start in all C1 cars and Main pipe pressure increases gradually.

In Car-C1:
- Wait for the Main Pipe pressure to increase above PM_MAX_PRESSURE in all units.

Read Pressure value and pressure switch signal, 
When increases over 9.8 bars, pressure switch signal changes
Compressors Stop on unit basis.

In Car-C1:
- Manually reduce the air pressure between PM_MIN_PRESSURE and PM_MAX_PRESSURE
Nothing happens.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the failures related to Compressor function
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the failures related to Compressor function

test_actions.text:
In Car-C1:
- Pneumatically isolate the Compressor
Check Inputs
Check Alarm
- Reset the pneumatic isolation of the Compressor.
Alarms Reset.

In Car-C1:
- Deactivate the Compressor Control Contactor 60K01 by removing cable from its terminal A1
Nothing happens

In Car-C1:
- Manually reduce the air pressure below PM_MIN_PRESSURE
Compressor does not start.
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Re-connect the cable in terminal A1 of the Compressor Control Contactor 60K01.
Compressor starts & Alarm Reset.

In Car-C1:
- Wait for the Compressor to Stop.

In Car-C1:
- Mechanically force the Contactor 60K01 power contacts
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Keep the Contactor 60K01 power contacts forced for more than 5 minutes.
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Unforce the Contactor 60K01 power contacts
Alarms Reset.

In Car-C1:
- Manually reduce the air pressure below PM_MIN_PRESSURE
Compressor starts.

In Car-C1:
- Remove the Air Dryer Cables 86120.25 and 86120.29 from TB XT73.171: 03
- Wait for 3 min with the compressor on.
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Re-connect the cables 86120.25 and 86120.29 in the TB XT73.171: 03
Alarm Reset.

In Car-C1:
- Remove the MRP Pressure Transducer sensor Cable 60151.01 from TB XT73.181: 12
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Re-connect the MRP Pressure Transducer sensor Cable 60151.01 in the TB XT73.181: 12
Alarm Reset.

In Car-C1:
- By using an 1.5sq.mm external cable, create a shorting link between TB XT14.113: 04b and XT14.113: 06b
- Manually reduce the air pressure below PM_MIN_PRESSURE
Compressor starts.
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Wait for Compressor to Stop automatically.
- Remove the 1.5sq.mm external cable between TB XT14.113: 04b and XT14.113: 06b
Alarm Reset.

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for LEFT direction light.
Lights on the LEFT side of the active cabin start blinking.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for RIGHT direction light.
Lights on the RIGHT side of the active cabin start blinking.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for LEFT direction light again.
Lights on the LEFT side of the active cabin start blinking.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for LEFT direction light again.
Lights switches OFF.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for RIGHT direction light.
Lights on the RIGHT side of the active cabin start blinking.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for RIGHT direction light again.
Lights switches OFF.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Interior Light control in AUTO Mode
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Interior Light control in AUTO Mode

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for Lighting mode (Auto/Manual) in Interior Lighting screen to select AUTO mode.
AUTO Mode will be enabled.

In Passenger Area:
- Simulate condition of ambient light above threshold value (Daytime) in all units
Interior Light luminosity changes to 40% level (DIMMED)

In Passenger Area:
- Simulate condition of ambient light below threshold value (Night time) in all units
Interior Light luminosity changes to 100% level (AUTO ON)

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Interior Light control in Manual Mode
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Interior Light control in Manual Mode

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for Lighting mode (Auto/Manual) in Interior Lighting screen to select MANUAL mode.
Manual Mode will be enabled.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for "low beam + passenger lights"
Interior Light luminosity changes to 100% level (MANUAL ON)

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for "low beam + passenger lights" again.
Interior Light luminosity changes to 40% level (DIMMED)

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Interior Light control in Emergency Mode
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Interior Light control in Emergency Mode
initial_conditions: - Interior Light is illuminating at 100% level.

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- Press the "Pantograph Down" pushbutton
Pantpgraph will be lowered and HV disconnected.
Wait for approx. 5 minutes.
Interior Light luminosity changes to 33% level (EMERGENCY)

In CABIN:
- Press the "Pantograph UP" pushbutton
Pantpgraph will be raised and HV connected again.
Interior Light luminosity changes to 40% level (DIMMED)
